svg.title: Wood League Chess wordmark
svg.desc: A wordmark for Wood League Chess on a cream paper ground. Stacked black serif display caps reading WOOD LEAGUE and CHESS, separated by a row of all six chess pieces — pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king — in teal, mustard, pink, sepia, deep red, and black, in the style of W.E.B. Du Bois Paris Exposition data visualizations.
